inputs.text: Local organizers are heading to the petition tables to collect signatures in an effort to protect southern Alberta’s watershed from coal mining. Water Not Coal, which was started by Corb Lund last month, is working to collect signatures for a citizen initiative petition. This petition would call on the Government of Alberta to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration."
